goal: Implement session-driven broadcast signing with PsbtSigner port, MnemonicPsbtSigner (simulated HW), HwPsbtSigner (real device), structured broadcast error contract, and frontend device-UX.

slicing_strategy.slice_a: PsbtSigner port + MnemonicPsbtSigner + ALLOW_DEV_MNEMONIC_SIGNING removal + rename + structured error contract (backend) + frontend error parsing (walking skeleton, regtest, no device)
slicing_strategy.slice_b: HwPsbtSigner + device UX + signerKind capability DTO + device prompt component

phases.phase_name: Slice (a) — Backend Foundation: PsbtSigner port, MnemonicPsbtSigner, flag removal, rename

steps.description: Capability matrix — parametrized allowed_on assertions for all signer/network combinations
steps.acceptance_criteria: Mnemonic signer permits signing on test networks (regtest, testnet); rejects mainnet; hardware signer permits all networks (asserted in Phase 04)

steps.description: Signer selection — init_from_mnemonic attaches MnemonicPsbtSigner
steps.acceptance_criteria: Mnemonic-initialized session has signing capability available on supported networks

steps.description: can_sign reflects network capability — signer present AND signer.allowed_on(network)
steps.acceptance_criteria: Session reports signing capability only when signer supports the active network; false otherwise

steps.description: HW session present but no signer attached → ReadOnly (not panic, not silent software sign)
steps.acceptance_criteria: Commit build with no signer attached produces read-only error; nothing is broadcast

steps.description: Mnemonic rejected on mainnet — fail fast, no sync/RPC/PSBT build
steps.acceptance_criteria: Mnemonic signer is rejected on mainnet; broadcast fails before any network I/O with a signer-not-allowed error

steps.description: Mnemonic on regtest without ALLOW_DEV_MNEMONIC_SIGNING env var — full broadcast succeeds
steps.acceptance_criteria: Mnemonic signer is permitted on regtest; broadcast completes successfully without the legacy env flag

steps.description: Happy path — mnemonic (simulated HW), regtest: build_signed_commit produces valid extractable commit tx
steps.acceptance_criteria: Mnemonic-initialized session produces a valid, extractable commit transaction that broadcasts through commit→reveal→confirmed

steps.description: Reveal still ephemeral — never calls PsbtSigner
steps.acceptance_criteria: Reveal transaction is signed by the ephemeral envelope key, not by the session signer

steps.description: Regression — downstream broadcast_commit_then_reveal and CommitFunding tests stay green
steps.acceptance_criteria: Existing broadcast_commit_then_reveal tests pass; CommitFunding port signature unchanged

steps.description: Structured-error mapping — all 10 error codes (broadcast_error_code pure helper)
steps.acceptance_criteria: Every backend error variant produces the correct structured error code per the DDD-8 mapping table with a non-empty human-readable message

steps.description: Session expiry during broadcast — OrchestratorUnauthorized maps to code=OrchestratorUnauthorized, boundary=BEFORE
steps.acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator session expiry produces an error with code indicating unauthorized access, before broadcast boundary, recovery=re-auth→retry

steps.description: Confirmation timeout — maps to code=Timeout, boundary=AFTER, recovery=resubmit-reveal, canResubmit=true
steps.acceptance_criteria: confirm_timeout_ms exceeded → code=Timeout, boundary=AFTER, recovery=resubmit-reveal, canResubmit=true

steps.description: BitcoinRpc failure BEFORE boundary — code=BitcoinRpc, boundary=BEFORE, recovery=retry-from-scratch, canResubmit=false
steps.acceptance_criteria: RPC error before submit_package → code=BitcoinRpc, boundary=BEFORE, recovery=retry-from-scratch, canResubmit=false (NIT-3)

steps.description: BitcoinRpc failure AFTER boundary — code=BitcoinRpc, boundary=AFTER, recovery=resubmit-reveal, canResubmit=true
steps.acceptance_criteria: RPC error after submit_package with live PendingReveal → code=BitcoinRpc, boundary=AFTER, recovery=resubmit-reveal, canResubmit=true

phases.phase_name: Slice (a) — Frontend: Structured error contract, error parsing, resubmit gating

steps.description: deriveBroadcastError parses structured JSON — returns {code, message, recovery} with kind-specific copy
steps.acceptance_criteria: Structured JSON error from backend is parsed into {code, message, recovery} with kind-specific user-facing copy

steps.description: deriveBroadcastError falls back for legacy string — returns {code:'Unknown', message:<raw>, recovery:'retry'}
steps.scenario_name: deriveBroadcastError falls back for legacy string
steps.acceptance_criteria: Given bare legacy error string → returns {code:'Unknown', message:<raw>, recovery:'retry'} (backward compatible)

steps.description: Resubmit-reveal gating — canResubmit=true ONLY when error.recovery==='resubmit-reveal'; false for HwDisconnected/HwUserRefused/HwSigningFailed/SignerNotAllowedOnNetwork/ReadOnly/OrchestratorUnauthorized
steps.acceptance_criteria: Resubmit control is enabled only when the error's recovery guidance is 'resubmit-reveal'; device-absent failure yields canResubmit=false

steps.description: Button auto-enables when canSign flips true — regression, no new gating code
steps.acceptance_criteria: Broadcast button is enabled when the session has signing capability; disabled when broadcasting or no capability

steps.description: Mnemonic path skips device prompt — card behaves byte-identically to R1.0.1 (regression)
steps.scenario_name: mnemonic path skips device prompt, card unchanged
steps.acceptance_criteria: Mnemonic session → no device prompt rendered; commit→reveal→confirmed advances exactly as R1.0.1

steps.description: Mnemonic/simulated-HW path keeps card behavior identical — only observable change is structured-error copy + corrected resubmit gating
steps.scenario_name: mnemonic path card behavior identical to R1.0.1
steps.acceptance_criteria: Mnemonic session: no device prompt, structured-error copy rendered, resubmit gating correct, disabled={isBroadcasting || !canSign} unchanged

phases.phase_name: Slice (a) — E2E: Mnemonic walking skeleton (regtest, no device)

steps.description: Regtest e2e — mnemonic walking skeleton: full broadcast on real Tauri binary with Palabras login, commit+reveal confirmed
steps.acceptance_criteria: Palabras login → approve proposal → broadcast → commit→reveal→confirmed; no device prompt appears

steps.description: Webdriver — mnemonic walking skeleton (slice a GATE): extend existing broadcast spec with Palabras login, phase progress commit→reveal→confirmed, no device prompt
steps.acceptance_criteria: Slice (a) completion gate: green CI with Palabras login, unified flow, phase progress correct, no device affordance

phases.phase_name: Slice (b) — Backend: HwPsbtSigner, device signing, HW error paths

steps.description: Signer selection — HW: init_from_xpub (with master_fingerprint) attaches HwPsbtSigner
steps.acceptance_criteria: Hardware wallet login (xpub + fingerprint) produces a session with hardware signing capability

steps.description: Happy path — HW on-device: sign_psbt runs in spawn_blocking (60s timeout), re-opens by fingerprint, taproot key-path signs
steps.acceptance_criteria: Hardware signer produces a signed PSBT via on-device signing with 60s timeout; commit finalizes and broadcasts

steps.description: Device-absent typed error before broadcast — HwDisconnected returned, broadcast_commit_then_reveal never reaches network
steps.acceptance_criteria: Hardware signing attempt with absent device returns disconnected error; nothing is broadcast

steps.description: Device disconnects mid-sign — 60s timeout or HID error → HwSigningFailed/HwDisconnected, no broadcast
steps.acceptance_criteria: Device disconnection during signing returns signing-failed or disconnected error; no broadcast occurs

steps.description: Fingerprint mismatch — different device plugged in → HwSigningFailed with wrong-device message, no broadcast
steps.acceptance_criteria: Mismatched hardware device produces signing-failed error indicating wrong device; no broadcast occurs

phases.phase_name: Slice (b) — Frontend: Device UX, signerKind capability DTO, device prompt

steps.description: Device-prompt state during HW pre-sign window — awaiting-device phase + BroadcastDevicePrompt renders 'Confirm on your device'
steps.scenario_name: device prompt renders during awaiting-device phase
steps.acceptance_criteria: UI displays device confirmation guidance during hardware signing phase

steps.description: signerKind capability DTO — admin_wallet_can_sign returns {canSign, signerKind, reason?}
steps.scenario_name: signerKind and canSignReason surfaced from capability hook
steps.acceptance_criteria: Capability query returns signing status, signer type, and optional unavailability reason; legacy bare-bool still accepted for graceful degradation

steps.description: Screen wiring — pass signerKind into controller + card; useCancelBroadcast adapts to BroadcastError type
steps.scenario_name: screen wires signerKind into controller and card
steps.acceptance_criteria: Broadcast proposal screen passes signer type and unavailability reason into the broadcast controller and card; cancel broadcast action uses structured error message for user feedback

phases.phase_name: Slice (b) — E2E: HW device integration (manual release checklist)

steps.description: Manual real-device path: connect Trezor/Ledger, log in via HW, broadcast approved proposal, confirm on-device, verify commit+reveal
steps.acceptance_criteria: Real Trezor/Ledger → HW login → broadcast → 'Confirm on your device' prompt → physical confirm → commit+reveal confirmed; unplug/refuse → HwDisconnected/HwUserRefused copy, no 'Resubmit reveal' control, nothing broadcast

test_doubles_policy.MockBitcoinRpc: Validates RPC method names, simulates submit_package success/unknown-method/RPC error; rejects invalid inputs
test_doubles_policy.MockOrchestratorClient: Validates auth token present, simulates 200/401/409 responses
test_doubles_policy.InMemoryCommitFunding: Validates network, address format, amount>0; returns deterministic signed Transaction
test_doubles_policy.FakeHwDevice: Simulates fingerprint match/mismatch, signing success/failure, device absent, user refusal; validates fingerprint non-empty before signing
test_doubles_policy.real_io: E2E-01 and E2E-02 use real Tauri binary, real BDK wallet, real regtest RPC; REG-01 uses real hardware device (manual)

quality_gates.slice_a_gate: E2E-02 (webdriver mnemonic walking skeleton) must be green before slice (b) begins
quality_gates.slice_b_gate: REG-01 (manual real-device path) must pass before release
